ops.oldText: terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other
ops.newText: terminated by either Party hereto upon 30 days written notice to the other

ops.text: 4.1.1 Renewal Notice; Renewal Pricing. HDI shall notify the Company at least 60 days before each renewal, and any price increase for a renewal period shall not exceed the lesser of CPI and 3%.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We shortened the non-renewal notice window to 30 days and added a 60-day pre-renewal reminder from HDI plus a renewal price increase cap at the lesser of CPI and 3%, consistent with our position that automatic renewals stay easy to exit and predictably priced.
proposal.summary: Shorten the Section 4.1 non-renewal notice window to 30 days and add a 60-day HDI renewal reminder with renewal price increases capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%.

mappings.element: Renewal only by mutual written agreement, unless the automatic-renewal alternative is complete.

mappings.quote: This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date

mappings.element: For automatic renewal, Customer opt-out on 30 days' notice.
For automatic renewal, Vendor reminder 60 days before renewal.
For renewal price increases, cap at the lesser of CPI and 3%.
